# Meta webhook fixtures

Shapes follow the official Meta webhook references verified on 2026-09-23
(see `docs/integrations/meta/webhooks.md`). Identifiers are placeholders
(`{{WABA_ID}}`, `{{PHONE_NUMBER_ID}}`, `{{WAMID}}`, `{{TS}}`) substituted by
`tests.conftest.load_fixture`. They are TEST DATA ONLY — never loaded into a
running environment and never shown in the UI.
